name: Geoffrey and Cynthia Taylor Bursary
summary: A bursary for continuing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander QUT students studying full time.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, confirmed through QUT's CATSID procedure.
Full-time (36 credit points or more) and completed at least 96 credit points of an eligible course.
how: Apply with the application form, with a CV, transcript, a response to the selection criteria and proof of descent.
catches: The terms found are the 2025 terms. Check the current round.
A separate Higher Degree by Research version exists.

source.label: QUT: Geoffrey and Cynthia Taylor Bursary

evidence.quote: is a bursary valued at $1,000, offered to continuing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students
Must be enrolled in a standard full-time enrolment program (36 credit points or more)
